title: AnalysisError
description: Safe error payload for API and terminal analysis outcomes. Never include stack traces, provider raw errors, object keys, or capability tokens.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. POSE_BODY_CROPPED.

safe_message.description: User-facing message with no internal details.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same upload may succeed.

remediation.description: Specific recording or retry guidance. Empty when not applicable.

correlation_id.description: Support / log correlation identifier (not a capability token).

details.description: Optional non-sensitive structured context for clients or support.

examples.safe_message: The full body was not visible throughout the stroke.
remediation: Keep both feet and the hitting arm in the frame.
